description:
## 1.4.0 (2026-11-12)

The complete 44-patch BadFella Patches bundle includes these improvements to our LinkedIn patches.

### ✨ New Features

* **LinkedIn:** add preset and custom hex accent colors alongside wallpaper colors; give Copy text, Download and Save PDF their own post-menu icons; refine the glass navigation bar with a spring selection pill, a thin rim and no press ripple while keeping its floating inset and full-height hiding behavior.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **LinkedIn:** use Morphe's class, string and method-call indexes for theme, share-link and GmsCore patch discovery, preserving the existing checks and Google identity.
* Keep the post-text extraction and failed PDF-download cleanup fixes from 1.3.1.

### Updating

Refresh Sources in Morphe Manager and patch the original app again with the same signing key. Accent colors require Material You; glass styling requires Glass navigation bar. Restart LinkedIn after changing colors. Experimental features remain experimental.

patches.name: Always show navigation bar
patches.description: Adds an option in BadFella Patches to keep the navigation bar on screen while you scroll.

patches.name: Anonymous profile viewing
patches.description: Adds an option (off by default, experimental) to visit profiles without being listed in "Who viewed your profile": the analytics events of profile pages are not sent.

patches.name: Block tracking
patches.description: Adds an option (off by default) to stop sending most LinkedIn analytics events.

patches.name: Copy post text
patches.description: Long pressing a post's text copies all of it, including the part behind "...more".

patches.name: Copy text
patches.description: Long press a post, comment or any other text to select and copy it in place, like on Reddit.

patches.name: Customize navigation bar
patches.description: Takes the bottom navigation buttons you pick off the bar, such as My Network, Post, Notifications, Jobs, Video or News. Each page still opens from the Menu and from links. Restart LinkedIn after changing the selection.

options.description: Removes the My Network button from the bottom navigation bar.
Removes the center Post button from the bottom navigation bar.
Removes the Notifications button from the bottom navigation bar.
Removes the Jobs button from the bottom navigation bar.
Removes the Video button from the bottom navigation bar.
Removes the News button from the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Dark app icon
patches.description: Black launcher icon with the white "in", instead of LinkedIn's blue. Chosen when patching: a launcher icon cannot switch with dark mode on its own.

patches.name: Disable double-tap like
patches.description: Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds a download button to the full screen photo, video and document viewer. Documents (PDFs and carousels) are saved as one PDF.

patches.name: Expand posts
patches.description: Adds an option (off by default, turned on in BadFella Patches) to show posts expanded by default. Tapping the text collapses them.

patches.name: Feed filters
patches.description: Adds optional filters (off by default, turned on in BadFella Patches): focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from others' activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".

patches.name: Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a spring selection pill and no press ripple.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Continue with Google" work in patched LinkedIn by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches.description: Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the Me panel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted, boosted and sponsored posts from the feed.

patches.name: Hide bottom tabs
patches.description: Adds switches to take My Network and Jobs out of the bottom bar.

patches.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches.description: Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.

patches.name: Icon-only post actions
patches.description: Adds a switch in BadFella Patches to show the Like, Comment, Repost and Send buttons under posts without their labels.

patches.name: Install next to LinkedIn
patches.description: Installs this build as a second LinkedIn beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options. Works as soon as you patch it in.

options.description: The second LinkedIn's package. Each part starts with a letter, with dots between the parts, and it can't be LinkedIn's own.
The name under the second LinkedIn's icon. It starts with a letter and holds up to 50 characters.

patches.name: Keep feed on reopen
patches.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn, instead of reloading it. Pull down or tap the "New posts" button to load new posts.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses wallpaper colors (Android 12+) or a preset/custom accent color (Android 10+) instead of LinkedIn blue and the green of selected filters, and Material 3 surface colors for backgrounds, cards, bars and borders. Some screens drawn by LinkedIn's servers may keep their own colors.

patches.name: Material icons in the bottom bar
patches.description: Replaces LinkedIn's Home, My Network, Notifications, Jobs and Video tab icons with Material icons (filled when selected, outlined otherwise). Chosen when patching.

options.description: Use Google's Material icons for the bottom bar tabs instead of LinkedIn's own.

patches.name: Messaging
patches.description: Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.

patches.name: More tab
patches.description: Lets you hide items of the More tab (Puzzle games, Groups, Events, Newsletters), or list them at the bottom of the profile menu.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Adds options (turned on in BadFella Patches) to hide the More, Jobs, Network and Notifications tabs of the navigation bar, its count badges and its labels.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Opens external links without LinkedIn's safety/go warning page.

patches.name: Pitch black
patches.description: Replaces the gray backgrounds of dark mode with black, and cards with a slightly lighter black, across the entire app. Takes effect when the system is in dark mode. Works with or without Material You.

patches.name: Post menu items
patches.description: Adds Copy text, Download photos and videos, and Save document as PDF to the ⋯ menu of posts, each with its own icon.

patches.name: Remove gaps and dividers
patches.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and lists are one flat surface.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.

patches.name: Swipe between feeds
patches.description: Swipe left and right on the home feed to switch between For you and Network, like on X.

patches.name: Swipe between tabs
patches.description: Swipe sideways to go to the next or previous tab of the navigation bar.

patches.name: Tap to hide in viewers
patches.description: Tap a video or document in full screen to hide the caption and buttons, like photos.

patches.name: Emby client unlock
patches.description: Enables local in-app feature gates using Kirlif's observed approach. Does not grant server Premiere entitlements.

patches.name: Emby remove Firebase and DataTransport
patches.description: Removes Firebase/DataTransport SDK classes and manifest components. Disables Firebase push messaging; keeps Cast and billing libraries.

patches.name: Pep Talk Elite features
patches.description: Enables local Elite features, labels the profile status and silences unavailable-purchase warnings from background product lookup. Keeps authentication and purchase handling; does not grant server-side access or a subscription.

patches.name: Disable analytics collection
patches.description: Disables declared analytics and crash collection and removes advertising permissions. Keeps Firebase Messaging and location permissions. Does not guarantee zero tracking.

patches.name: Restore notifications
patches.description: Restores Firebase certificate metadata on re-signed apps, with an Android 17 compatible token setup. Push delivery still requires device testing.

patches.name: Restore reminder alarms
patches.description: Restores task/reminder alarm scheduling on re-signed apps.

patches.name: TickTick Premium
patches.description: Enables client-side premium features and limits. Does not grant server-side AI access or a subscription.

patches.name: Wanderlog Pro features
patches.description: Enables local Pro feature checks, removes subscription prompts and auto-opening paywalls, hides the home Pro star, labels the profile button Pro Activated and brands the billing screen. Makes the app theme follow the device dark-mode setting, because the app's own dark mode entry is Pro-only and the preference is set by Wanderlog's servers on subscription. Keeps the patched bundle in place by disabling Expo OTA updates. Does not grant server-run AI, downloads, flight tracking, Google Maps export or a subscription.

patches.name: Remote ATV ad-free
patches.description: Disables advertising, restores startup and replaces premium activation with a local ad-free status. Removes the home banner and its spacing. Does not create a server subscription.

patches.name: Torrent Search Revolution local Pro
patches.description: Enables the local Pro/ad-free branches, including search, native and banner ads and Pro settings. Preserves startup callbacks. Reviewed on 2.3.5; changed app bytecode requires review. Does not grant a Pro Key subscription or server entitlement.

release_notes:
## BadFella Patches v1.5.0-dev.1

The complete 45-patch BadFella Patches bundle includes ChatGPT clone support and the LinkedIn drawer layout fix.

### ChatGPT 1.2026.307

* Keep the original OAuth callback in sign-in requests instead of deriving an unregistered address from the clone package. The clone retains its separate Android package and app data.
* Check the native redirect builder before applying the change and reject changed or ambiguous code.
* If Android asks which app should handle the sign-in callback, choose the copy. Actual sign-in remains subject to the service's checks; a successful patch does not establish account sign-in compatibility.

### LinkedIn 4.1.1271

* Keep BadFella Patches below Groups with the same inset card width, icon and spacing as Puzzle games.

### Updating

Enable pre-releases for the BadFella Patches source in Morphe Manager, refresh Sources and patch the original app again with the same signing key.
